Russian visual deception

AI-generated imagery, staged flag displays and other deceptive material documented by Ukraine Daily Update’s analysts. Short case descriptions below retain their assessments and questions, alongside attributed source reporting.

Russian Assassination Attempt

2026-07-31 · Event 4587590 · Documentation

49.978957, 36.251441

Original entry: Ukrainian National Police, in cooperation with the SBU, National Guard, and prosecutor's office, detained a 69-year-old resident of Kharkiv. This individual, recruited by Russian special services operating under a false flag, attempted to assassinate Ihor Obolenskyi, commander of the «Khartia» corps. The plot involved misleading the man with AI-generated fake evidence and providing him with firearms via a courier. He was detained under Article 208 of the Criminal Procedure Code of Ukraine. National Police of Ukraine The Security Service of Ukraine, National Guard, Prosecutor's Office, and National Police detained a 69-year-old resident of Kharkiv who was recruited by Russian special services under a false flag. The individual attempted to assassinate Ihor Obolenskyi, commander of the 'Khartia' corps, and was provided with a firearm by Russian special services for this purpose. The detainee faces charges of premeditated murder and illegal handling of weapons. Security Service of Ukraine

Forged Sumy evacuation message

t.me/Sumy_news_ODA/36571 · voxukraine.org/ru/fotofejk-sumskaya-oga-pryznala-maroderstvo-normalnym-yavlenyem-v-zone-boevyh-dejstvyj

Original entries, coordinates & all sources (1)

Russian Disinformation Campaign

2025-06-25 · Event 3696246 · Documentation

50.908262, 34.785751

Original entry: Russian forces spread a fake screenshot on a pro-Russian Telegram channel, attributed to Oleh Hryhorov, Head of Sumy Regional Military Administration. The fake post recommended taking money, household appliances, and other valuables during evacuation due to alleged increased looting in combat zones. The Sumy Regional Military Administration officially stated that this information is false and such a publication did not appear on their official resources, classifying it as an information attack aimed at escalating panic, destabilizing the border region of Sumy Oblast, and undermining trust in authorities. Sumy Regional Military Administration

Original entries, coordinates & all sources (3)

Pro-Russian Propaganda

2025-09-23 · Event 3761757 · Documentation

48.042158, 37.961857

Original entry: The head of the regional prosecutor's office notified a former deputy of the Makiivka City Council, from the 'Party of Regions', of suspicion for collaborative activities. In 2023, she became 'deputy general director' of a fake 'republican media holding'. Under her leadership, 22 printed and electronic publications spread materials approving the capture of the region and discrediting Ukrainian authorities. She also announced the release of the first Russian-language print edition in 8 years in the so-called 'DPR' territory. A news anchor for the propaganda TV channel 'Oplot TV', controlled by the so-called 'DPR Ministry of Information' and operating from Donetsk, is suspected of collaboration. On air, she openly justifies the actions of Russian forces, covers reports featuring speeches by pseudo-officials, spreads Kremlin narratives, and in one segment, demonstrated 'military chronicles' of shelling Ukrainian cities, commenting on this as 'successes' of the Russian army. A correspondent for the propaganda TV channel 'Oplot TV', controlled by the so-called 'DPR Ministry of Information' and operating from Donetsk, is suspected of collaboration. She publicly supports the actions of Russian forces, and participates in filming stories with Russian military personnel returned from captivity, in which fabricated stories about alleged abuse by Ukrainian defenders are told. Donetsk Oblast Prosecutor's Office

Websites copying official Ukrainian branding

The SBU reports Russian-run websites and social accounts copying Ukrainian government and media branding for disinformation, personal-data collection and recruitment.

t.me/SBUkr/18692 · www.ssu.gov.ua/novyny/sbu-zaklykaie-hromadian-buty-pylnymy-i-poperedzhaie-rf-aktyvno-stvoriuie-feikovi-storinky-derzhavnykh-orhaniv-ukrainy

Original entries, coordinates & all sources (1)

Russian IPSO

2026-10-07 · Event 4864757 · Documentation

50.428637, 30.53732

Original entry: Russian special services are actively creating fake websites and social media pages imitating official Ukrainian state bodies and domestic media. These resources are used to conduct information-psychological special operations and disinformation campaigns aimed at destabilizing the socio-political situation within Ukraine and undermining its international standing. They also exploit these resources to extract personal data from Ukrainians, often by hacking user accounts that subscribe to fake pages and channels, subsequently using this information for recruitment and collecting confidential data. Information regarding the combat and operational work of Ukraine's Defense and Security Forces is of particular interest to Russian forces. The Department of Cyber Security of the Security Service of Ukraine has identified and blocked over 50 resources that, by their appearance and positioning, copied the branding of the Security Service of Ukraine. Fake human-rights resource

The SBU reports that an IT specialist created a fake human-rights resource for a pro-Kremlin propagandist to discredit Ukrainian activists.

Original entries, coordinates & all sources (1)

Russian Collaboration

2025-07-18 · Event 4220700 · Documentation

48.92308518482823, 24.70070744784209

Original entry: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) detained an IT specialist who remotely worked for the Russian occupation administration in Kherson Oblast. The specialist created fake 'human rights' resources to discredit Ukrainian activists, developed a website for a pro-Kremlin propagandist, and fulfilled over 40 orders from Russian commercial companies. During searches, evidence including computer equipment, phones, and bank cards was seized. The individual faces charges for aiding the aggressor state. Security Service of Ukraine
